description: A structure satisfies the sentence asserting at least \(n\) distinct elements if and only if its cardinality is at least \(n\).
signature:
FirstOrder.Language.Sentence.realize_cardGe.{u, v, w} (L : FirstOrder.Language) {M : Type w} [L.Structure M] (n : ℕ) :
  M ⊨ FirstOrder.Language.Sentence.cardGe L n ↔ ↑n ≤ Cardinal.mk M
